name: Preview Slot Fix
description: Stops a stream preview from freeing the provider connection of a channel that is still playing (Dispatcharr 0.31.0 and 0.32.0). Not needed from Dispatcharr 0.33.0, which fixes this itself: there the plugin does nothing and can be removed.
author: andyj682

fields.description: No settings needed. Enable the plugin, then restart the Dispatcharr container. Previews keep working as before; they just keep their own connection record instead of sharing one with live channels. Dispatcharr 0.33.0 and later fix this themselves; on those versions the plugin installs nothing and can be removed.

actions.label: Show status
actions.description: Report whether the fix is active and list the preview connections it is currently holding.
